heading: About Me
subtitle: Passionate about creating innovative web solutions that make a difference
paragraphs: I'm a designer-developer hybrid who loves fusing art with technology to craft immersive digital experiences. From building full-stack applications to creating 2D/3D motion graphics and animation, I enjoy working at the intersection of creativity and code.

While I'm capable of building complete apps on my own, I thrive in collaborative environments where ideas grow stronger as a team. Always curious and open to new tools, I welcome challenges that push me to learn, adapt, and innovate.
